errors.evidence: From the legend and axis labels, the green bars correspond to “该日全球确诊数量” and the blue line corresponds to “有关covid-19新闻数,” not the other way around.

errors.text_span: 图表中蓝色曲线代表每日新增患者人数，绿色柱状图代表有关COVID-19的新闻报道数目
errors.evidence: The description reverses the legend mapping: the bars are the daily confirmed cases and the line is the COVID-19 news count.

errors.text_span: 在2022年7月12日左右，新闻媒体报道数目达到峰值，约为3000篇

errors.text_span: 每日新增患者人数的蓝色曲线在图表中波动，范围从约400000到1600000人
errors.evidence: The line is plotted on the right axis with values in the thousands, so this range is not correct for the blue curve.

The description does not mention that the chart is a combined bar-and-line chart with two y-axes (left and right) linked to different series, beyond a simple color distinction.
